name: Citizenship by Birth (Filiation and Birth-in-Territory Provisions)

qualifying_event.description: A legitimate (or legitimated) child born in Cote d'Ivoire is Ivoirian unless both parents are foreign nationals (Code de la Nationalite, Article 6). A child born abroad to at least one Ivoirian parent acquires citizenship by descent (Article 7), including children born outside marriage where paternity or maternity is legally established.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; proof of at least one parent's Ivoirian nationality, or (for births in Cote d'Ivoire) proof that at least one parent is not foreign.

requirement_groups.name: Born in Cote d'Ivoire, not both parents foreign

requirements.blocker_text: Born in Cote d'Ivoire, where at least one parent is not a foreign national at the time of birth.

requirement_groups.name: Born abroad to an Ivoirian parent

requirements.blocker_text: At least one parent was an Ivoirian national at the time of birth, whether the child is born in or out of marriage (with paternity/maternity legally established for out-of-marriage births).

sources.title: ecoi.net (Austrian Red Cross/ACCORD country-of-origin information network) -- Code de la Nationalite Ivoirienne, Articles 6-7: birth-in-territory citizenship unless both parents foreign, and descent-based citizenship for children born abroad to an Ivoirian parent; Article 49, relief mechanism for automatic dual nationals

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Cote d'Ivoire). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-2 only, same constraint as this build's other citizenship files (Cote d'Ivoire's own official gazette portal was not reached to tier-1 depth). Article 6's 'unless both parents are foreign' formulation is a MODIFIED jus soli -- distinct from pure jus soli (automatic regardless of parentage, e.g. the US) and from pure jus sanguinis (parent's citizenship required, no birthplace effect) -- it grants citizenship by birthplace UNLESS BOTH parents are foreign, meaning a child of one Ivoirian and one entirely foreign parent, born in-country, qualifies automatically without needing Article 7's separate descent test. This structural nuance is disclosed explicitly since it's easy to conflate with either pure model. dual_citizenship_allowed TRUE is the same Article-49-based inference used in ci_citizenship_naturalisation.json, flagged there for re-verification.
